amount.description: What the refund settles of the credit, in its currency: at most what is left of it (CREDIT-05).

credit_id.description: The credit refunded: a posted vendor credit, or a payment of bills with an amount unapplied.

date.description: The day the money came in.

fx_rate.description: For a credit in another currency refunded into an account in that currency: base currency per one unit, as on the bank's advice. Left out, the cascade's rate for the date (ENG-40).

money_account_id.description: The bank, card or wallet account it came into: an active money account in the credit's currency or in the base currency.

received.description: For a credit in another currency refunded into a base-currency account: what the account received, in the base currency. Required then, and only then (LEDGER-27).
